description.to:
Outcome: Implements PPY-bd1c6e. Tenant.state changes only through one function, driven by Prospectus payment and cancellation events (whether past-due suspends automatically is owner decision 5; Prospectus billing today never suspends on its own). Effects: past_due shows a banner; suspended removes the editor, curator and admin write claims at the next token issue (members keep read claims, so the newsroom is read-only and export works), stops monitors, scheduled jobs and model spend, and keeps the public site up; deleted_pending starts the stated grace period, then deletion (PPY-62f10d). Every change is logged and the admin is told by email.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): Tenant model, amplify/functions/tenant-claims (state-aware claims), new state-change function, monitoring router (skip suspended tenants), procedure runner and scheduled tasks, the newsroom banner.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-lifecycle.feature):
Scenario: A suspended tenant can read and export but not write
    Given "alpha" is suspended
    When its admin signs in
    Then stories open read-only, saving is refused, and export works

Scenario: Suspension stops spending
    Given "alpha" is suspended
    When its monitors are due
    Then they do not run and no model call is made

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-0bb0fd, PPY-31c45c, PPY-6d9a6d, PPY-bdc4ee. Blocks PPY-62f10d, PPY-d7c279. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-bd1c6e.

Testing: Behave with a fake event source.
Rollout: Shared stack.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a wrong suspension locks a paying customer out. Mitigation: suspension needs the payment event plus the grace period; a platform operator can reverse it in one command; the runbook covers it.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: changes: claims depend on tenant state.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
